acceptance: 2026-11-25 project LG OLED55C3RLA, firmware 43.21.71, SDK 11.2.0. macOS ARM64 cytv 0.24.3 source installer over saved Root SSH verified the signed published FHD Home 1.21.0 and final Helper 0.11.0 IPK SHA-256 2a0b2beb51215547fbf43b2f49abe0b49e36571ec675ba228e84d48254f8494c. Initial startup readback was unavailable until explicit Start. No pending operation. Installed launcher manifest and JS, Helper controller and ARM relay match their selected IPKs. One paired network HOME from Media Player reached LG Home at 0.27 s and CYTV at 4.71 s, where it held for one second. The same pair passed a 15-second network standby/Wake-on-LAN cycle with Ambient off. The Helper logged resume-already-foreground. All four network arrows moved selection before any Home input. The popup capability on this firmware reuses the earlier rejection evidence because its application IDs, implementation and permissions match. Physical input, HD, Developer Mode, sound, cold boot, OTA and full rollback were not checked in this compatibility probe.
